articles.title: VERSANT Begins Trading on Nasdaq Today as Independent Company Following Completion of Comcast Spin-Off
articles.mainIdea: VERSANT Begins Trading on Nasdaq Today as Independent Company Following Completion of Comcast Spin-Off
articles.summary: Business Wire: VERSANT Begins Trading on Nasdaq Today as Independent Company Following Completion of Comcast Spin-Off. NEW YORK, January 05, 2026--VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) today announced the completion of its spin-off from Comcast (Nasdaq: CMCSA). VERSANT will commence trading today on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the ticker symbol VSNT. Related tickers mentioned: VSNT.
